newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF likely to auction 4-year notes on Tues - traders.
newsitem.headline: MOF likely to auction 4-year notes on Tues - traders.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer four-year government notes through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, bond traders said on Monday.
The MOF consulted market participants earlier on Monday about demand for the new four-year notes, traders said.
They said the coupon rate was likely to be set at either 1.3 percent or 1.4 percent, down from 1.7 percent in the previous four-year note auction held in May.
They said the offer amount was likely to be 400 billion yen, down from 500 billion yen in the previous auction.
